en: The black-and-white image shows a bustling ski slope with skiers scattered across the snowy landscape. There are visible ski tracks, a ski lift running up the mountain, and a small ski hut or building near the bottom where people gather. A skier with traditional gear appears in the foreground, and several pine trees are dotted around the slope. The overall scene is active and lively in a high-altitude winter sports environment.
